title: Tutoriais Interativos de Microsserviços - Definição de Tutorial
description: Schema do arquivo de configuração (index.json) de um tutorial interativo da plataforma

title.description: The display title of the scenario

description.description: A short summary of what the scenario covers

details.description: Contains the scenario's intro, steps, and finish content

steps.description: Ordered list of steps the user completes

imageid.description: Identifier of the backend image/environment to provision (e.g. a Kubernetes cluster setup)

report.description: Optional performance report: at the end of the tutorial the student may send name, enrollment number and score to the instructor's remote endpoint (e.g. a Google Apps Script Web App bound to a spreadsheet)

endpoint.description: URL that receives the performance record via HTTP POST (JSON body)

token.description: Value sent along with the record so the endpoint can discard submissions from other sources (not a strong secret: it is visible in the repository)

text.description: Path to a markdown file containing the content to display

background.description: Path to a shell script executed in the background when this block is shown (e.g. environment setup)

text.description: Path to a markdown file with the step's instructions

verify.description: Path to a shell script that automatically verifies the user's completion of this step

points.description: Score/points awarded to the user upon successful completion of this step

fileTarget.description: Points the step to a specific file (and optionally a line within it) that should be opened/displayed alongside the step's instructions

name.description: Path or name of the file to display for this step

line.description: Line number within the file to focus/scroll to (optional)
